# Pendoring

> > Pendoring is South Africa's premier indigenous language awards platform celebrating creative excellence in advertising, design, and digital innovation across 11 official South African languages.

Pendoring hosts annual awards competitions, student challenges, and conferences dedicated to promoting indigenous language use in creative industries and technology. The platform supports multilingual content creation, language preservation, and digital innovation through competitions like the Radio Challenge, Polokèalô design awards, and Indigenous Language Tech Challenge.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous Languages
- South African Languages

## Main Competitions & Awards

- [Pendoring – The indigenous language awards](https://www.pendoring.co.za): Pendoring's main homepage showcasing indigenous language awards across South African languages.
- [Home 2025 – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/home): 2025 homepage for Pendoring indigenous language awards and event registration.
- [Radio Challenge – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/radio-challenge): Radio Challenge competition for students to create indigenous language radio advertising scripts.
- [Polokèalô](https://polokelo.pendoring.co.za): Polokèalô student design awards and competition platform for creative advertising work.
- [Santam x Pendoring Design Challenge – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/santam-x-pendoring-design-challenge): Design challenge with Santam for logo redesign and branding competition for students.

## Innovation & Technology Initiatives

- [Indigenous Language Tech Challenge – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/indigenous-language-tech-challenge): Tech innovation challenge for indigenous language preservation with seed funding and hackathon.
- [Indigenous Language Imbizo 2025 – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/indigenous-language-imbizo-2025): 2025 conference on indigenous language technology and digital innovation in South Africa.
- [Indigenous Language Imbizo – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/indigenous-language-imbizo): Conference on indigenous language preservation, multilingualism and digital storytelling.

## Awards & Merchandise

- [Additional certificates – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/product/additional-certificates): Order additional award certificates for Pendoring Awards winners.
- [Additional trophies – Pendoring](https://www.pendoring.co.za/product/additional-pendoring-trophy): Order additional award trophies including Umpetha and Overall Student trophies.
